controls.summary: Use the device editor for operating rules and machine interactions; movement remains available. Escape pauses.

objective: Win 2 encounter(s) using type strengths, guarding, healing and limited energy. Keep at least one companion standing.
title: Elemental Companions
subtitle: Elemental Trials
learning_objectives: Learn the platform controls, missions and progression.
Discuss the institute and college VMGO, PILOs and CILOs using instructor-provided statements.
win_condition: Operate the mission's required device ports using the instruction editor, then: Defeat every encounter while at least one companion remains standing.
lose_condition: Every companion is defeated or the 600-second time limit expires before completion.
hint: Program the controller, run it, inspect the live input/output and revise rejected operations. INTERACT requires an eligible nearby port.
